title: 1893 Franco-Siamese crisis
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1893 Franco-Siamese crisis", at revision 1374343940, opens: "The Franco-Siamese crisis of 1893, known in Thailand as the Incident of Rattanakosin Era 112 was a conflict between the French Third Republic and the Kingdom of Siam. Auguste Pavie, French vice-consul in Luang Prabang in 1886, was the chief agent in furthering French interests in Laos." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1359846, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Incident between France and Siam". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
